parrafo_1.es: Marcello y el equipo de City Beautiful Painter pintan interiores y exteriores en toda la zona de Orlando, desde repintados completos de casas hasta oficinas que necesitan estar listas a la mañana siguiente. Los clientes que los llaman de nuevo para puertas, molduras y gabinetes dicen que la calidad se sostiene con una segunda mirada.
parrafo_1.en: Marcello and the City Beautiful Painter crew handle interior and exterior painting across the Orlando area, from full home repaints to offices that need to be ready the next morning. Clients who call them back for doors, trim and cabinets say the quality holds up to a second look.

parrafo_2.es: Una clienta necesitaba repintar el exterior rápido para cumplir con un plazo de su HOA y consiguió una cita en pocas semanas, con el equipo incluso ayudando a mover muebles de exterior. Otro cliente llamó de nuevo después de un repintado completo de interior para que también terminaran puertas y molduras. El patrón se repite: una vez que City Beautiful Painter hace el primer trabajo, los clientes no buscan a nadie más para el siguiente.
parrafo_2.en: One client needed their exterior repainted fast to meet an HOA deadline and got an appointment within a few weeks, with the crew even helping move outdoor furniture. Another client called back after a full interior repaint to have doors and trim finished too. The pattern repeats: once City Beautiful Painter does the first job, clients do not look elsewhere for the next one.

items.quote: I had an amazing experience with Marcello and his team, they completed the job in a timely manner as previously agreed, they were very professional, and did an amazing job with the painting of my entire home. It looks like a brand new home once again.!

I am so glad I went with Marcello and his crew. I got about 5 quotes as I was looking for great service with reasonable pricing. I was forced to paint my exterior by my HOA and needed it done soon, he was able to get me in within a few weeks. They were professional and courteous. He wasn't pushy at all. Above all did a great paint job. They even helped me move some outdoor furniture because my husband wasn't home.

I moved into a new office space on Wednesday. I called to see if I could get my office painted the very next day (Thursday). They managed to get me an early morning appointment very last minute. Painters were prompt, professional and definitely 5 stars. Great service and highly recommend! Thank you City Beautiful Painter!
